known_measurement_limits: Claim correctness, claim completeness, and full faithfulness require reviewed full-evidence or calibrated judge scoring and are not inferred from string matching.
Source-display exactness proxy verifies validated citations, no rejected IDs, cited status, and one visible source per resolved cited ID; the browser deliberately does not display raw internal IDs.
Conversation history is passed as untrusted bounded context to the pipeline, but persistence/ownership flows are measured separately because the frozen runtime has history disabled.
